neighbours.label: patience: the call or quality of being patient (please be patient, impatience, paciencia)
fire: The page loads slowly on older phones, so please be patient while it opens.
The queue at the post office was long, and I could feel my impatience growing.
Thank you for your patience while we repair the damaged line.
Learning the violin takes years, so try to be patient with yourself.
Les travaux prendront du temps, merci de votre patience et de votre compréhension.
Teachers of small children need endless patience and a sense of humour.
Le pedimos paciencia mientras actualizamos el sitio web.
He waited patiently for the doctor, reading the same magazine twice.
quiet: The page loads slowly on older phones, so try again on a laptop later.
The queue at the post office was long, and I counted forty people ahead of me.
Thank you for your email about the damaged line on our street.
Learning the violin takes years, so buy a decent instrument early on.
Les travaux prendront du temps, la route restera fermée jusqu'en mai.
Teachers of small children need good shoes and a loud voice.
El sitio web estará cerrado mientras lo actualizamos.
He sat in the waiting room for the doctor, reading the same magazine twice.

notes: Card: please| be (patient) 189, imp|at|ience, pac|iencia, Arabic sabr; output direction suppresses patience/patiently/patient (the + pole promotes the word). Near misses keep slow-service and waiting scenes without asking for or describing patience.
